high_beam.name: High beams on
high_beam.what_to_do: Switch to low beams when other drivers are ahead or approaching.

turn_left.name: Left turn signal
turn_left.summary: The left turn signal (or hazard lights) is on.
turn_left.what_to_do: Turn it off once you have finished turning. If it blinks very fast, a bulb may have failed.

turn_right.name: Right turn signal
turn_right.summary: The right turn signal (or hazard lights) is on.
turn_right.what_to_do: Turn it off once you have finished turning. If it blinks very fast, a bulb may have failed.

abs.name: Anti-lock brakes (ABS)
abs.summary: The anti-lock braking system has a fault, or is switched off.
abs.what_to_do: Your normal brakes usually still work, but ABS may not help in a hard stop. Drive carefully and have it checked soon.

brake_system.name: Brake system warning
brake_system.summary: Possible low brake fluid, a brake fault, or the parking brake still on.
brake_system.what_to_do: Check the parking brake is off. If the light stays on, stop safely and have the brakes inspected before driving on.

parking_brake.name: Parking brake
parking_brake.summary: The parking brake is applied, or its system has a fault.
parking_brake.what_to_do: Release the parking brake before driving. If the light stays on after releasing it, have it checked.

battery.name: Charging system (battery)
battery.summary: The battery is not being charged properly (battery, alternator or belt).
battery.what_to_do: Switch off extra electrical loads and get it checked soon: the car can stop running when the battery runs down.

oil_pressure.name: Engine oil pressure
oil_pressure.what_to_do: Stop in a safe place and switch the engine off. Check the oil level. Driving with low oil pressure can destroy the engine.

check_engine.name: Check engine
check_engine.summary: The engine or emissions system has detected a fault.
check_engine.what_to_do: Have it diagnosed soon. If the light is flashing, avoid driving and get service right away.

tire_pressure.name: Tire pressure
tire_pressure.summary: One or more tires may be low on air, or the monitoring system has a fault.
tire_pressure.what_to_do: Check and correct the tire pressures at the next stop.

airbag.name: Airbag / restraint system
airbag.summary: The airbag or seat-belt restraint system has a fault, or is still doing its start-up check.
airbag.what_to_do: If the light stays on after the engine has been running, have the system inspected: airbags may not work in a crash.
